column2: Damn! There are so many of these bastards...
Hey, you damn old man! If you can do something with magic, hurry up and do it!!
Good grief... Born from the earth, only to return to it so soon...
But I shall not let your bodies go to waste!
For us $$大神官$$s to wield the power of $$魔道$$,
we always need a great quantity of $$血$$ offered as a $$生けにえ$$ to serve as its catalyst.
And when that amount of $$血$$ reaches its fill...
Watch closely! This is the sacred power passed down since ancient times...
Gah! T-the $$死体$$... They're moving... on their own!?
And using the bodies of these zombies, I can do this as well!!
An ultimate magic from ancient times...
